prelaunch_updates.text: Quip testnet passed 100,000 blocks; the team repeats that the only major step left before mainnet is an external chain audit. Mainnet and TGE remain undated; no QUIP token exists yet.
Verona teased verUSD: 'verUSD is on its way. Our biggest launch yet is next.' No date, mechanics, backing or contract published. Any verUSD token before an official Verona post is a scam.

OPEN CAMPAIGN (founder): Arthur Hayes says the Flop testnet/airdrop is four days away (Tue 11/24, tentative) and that mainnet FLOP tokens will go to users who give useful, constructive feedback on X and GitHub about the network's policy choices. Criteria, amounts and how rewards are claimed are not published. No token exists yet; any FLOP token is a scam.

Flop Labs released CLI v0.7.0/v0.7.1 and Python SDK v0.3.3 and added a public validator/RPC operator application form on GitHub (one per team; a testnet application only records interest until testnet intake is announced; never post keys). Node operators only.

TermiX: holders of a Binance Agent ID can install TermiX Skills through their linked agent and connect its Agentic Wallet for 50 TP (TermiX points), one reward per wallet. A new task inside the existing points campaign; TGE still undated, any TMT token now is a scam.

GenLayer published a revised GEN tokenomics paper (Wed 11/18): only 673.24M GEN (16.0% of supply) unlocks at TGE, down from 1,275.75M (30.4%). Foundation (840M) now 410.74M at TGE, 145.76M over months 1-2, 283.5M on the 48-month contributor schedule; Early Ecosystem 25% at TGE then 6.25%/month for 12 months. Supply (4.2B), allocation sizes, investor schedules and community airdrop terms unchanged; first-year issuance ~361M GEN (8.6%). TGE still undated; any GEN token now is a scam.

GenLayer restated Pre-Mainnet Staking: airdropped GEN counts from day one and, on THE DAY (launch day, still undated), starts staking automatically and earns Staking Points daily with no action needed. No contract or venue yet; any GEN token now is a scam.

Arthur Hayes: becoming a FLOP miner, validator, KOL or user needs no application or approval; point an AI agent at flop.finance/intro to get set up. Flop Labs shipped CLI v0.6.0 and Python SDK v0.3.2 and fixed devnet wallet enrollment. Testnet and airdrop still Tue 11/24 (tentative); devnet earns nothing. No token exists.

TermiX x Kaito creator campaign: total reward pool raised from 0.3% to 0.4% of the TermiX token supply and the campaign extended through TGE, with new epochs to come. TGE itself is still undated. Campaign already known (we are in TermiX Points); not a new campaign.

Arthur Hayes: FLOP block rewards are weighted by inference processed (measured in floating-point work); the team will not advise on miner hardware. Flop Labs released miner v0.2.0, miner-vllm-toploc v0.2.0 and SDK v0.5.2 on GitHub ahead of the tentative Tue 11/24 testnet. No token yet; any FLOP token is a scam.
